name: Mr Chapman
source:
Ex-employee of 'The Council Of The Unseen'.  After the destruction of the organisation, his life spirals out of control and he ends up living at The Violet Hotel, where he tries to live on money from dodgy jobs.

Is practically conned into buying Emily, the talking kettle
